welcome.title: The gel dashboard
welcome.text: Pick lanes from any analysed gel and look at them together: the gel itself, the intensity profiles, the purity, the bands. Nothing is saved or changed here. A one-minute tour; leave it at any time with <kbd>Esc</kbd>.

steps.title: Every analysed gel and its lanes
steps.text: A gel is listed once one of its lanes has a densitometry, newest first. Open a gel and tick its lanes, from one gel or several, up to 20. A lane without a densitometry cannot be ticked.

steps.title: Find a gel
steps.text: Filter the list by gel file, analysis name or sample name.

steps.title: The whole gel of one lane
steps.text: The gel of the lane in focus, with that lane's bands and its intensity profile. Bands hides the outlines, Dim the other lanes makes the lane stand out, Analysis opens its analysis page.

steps.title: The ticked lanes, compared
steps.text: One card per lane, then the lanes side by side on a common kDa axis, their overlaid intensity profiles, their purity or western readout, a band's detail and the band table. Lanes of different assays are shown one assay at a time.

steps.title: Keep this selection
steps.text: Open as comparison takes the ticked lanes to the comparison page, where they can be saved and reported. The page's address also keeps the selection: bookmark it to come back.
